free_tier.stated: Free Tier for 12 months: 1,000 build minutes a month on the standard 4 vCPU / 8 GB instance, 5 GB of CDN storage, 15 GB a month of data transfer out, 500,000 server-side rendering requests and 100 GB-hours a month of SSR duration. After 12 months every line is metered, and new accounts since 2025-07-15 get up to USD 200 in credits on a free plan that lasts 6 months.

retention.stated: the 12-month clock ends the allowance regardless of use, and the build instance is the only 4 vCPU / 8 GB shape, which makes the build minutes the useful part rather than the hosting.

chaining: 100 GB-hours a month of SSR is the closest free analogue to a small always-on server, and 1,000 build minutes on 4 vCPU is a real build runner; both end at 12 months, so the composition is a one-year window to build and measure rather than a home.

notes: The 100 GB-hours of SSR duration is the number worth having: at 1 GB of provisioned memory it is 100 hours of server-side render a month, roughly three hours a day, and it is the only hyperscaler allowance denominated in GB-hours.
